builtin.labels.about: Let an on-device model fill in the phase and activity of a call that did not name them
builtin.labels.section.agreement.empty: No shadow checks yet: they need model labels and the shadow check turned on.
builtin.labels.section.agreement.title: Agreement with explicit labels (last 30 days)
builtin.labels.section.agreementnote.bod: Shadow check: for some calls that carried their own phase or activity, the model also chose one, and only the numbers are kept, never any text. Agreement means the model chose the same label as the caller. It is not calibrated accuracy: the callers' labels are a biased sample, and a model that does not decide counts as a disagreement. Use it to pick the agreement needed (two of three or all three), not as proof that model labels are right.
builtin.labels.section.intro.body: Off by default. When on, a call that arrives without a phase or activity gets them chosen by a model on this gateway: the start of its first message is read in memory by the backend you choose, and nothing of it is stored or logged. A label chosen by a model is shown as (model) in usage reports; a label the caller gave always wins and is never replaced. Labels are data for reports and never give access to anything. When turned on, the gateway fills the phase and activity of unlabelled calls with the on-device or local model you choose.

builtin.upstreams.about: Send the knowledge of a project or team to another gateway, by hand or automatically
builtin.upstreams.section.intro.body: A link sends only what it covers. By hand, only Push Now sends; a link set to automatic sends its changes by itself, about a minute after the last change. In submit mode (the default) what arrives there is a proposal that the upstream's reviewers accept or reject; in publish mode it is written there directly, and a note that changed there is listed as a conflict for you to settle. Dry Run asks what exists there and writes nothing, there or here.
builtin.upstreams.section.links.action.a: Changes are no longer sent by themselves: only Push Now sends. What changed in the meantime goes at the next push.
Turn automatic push off for {label} to {upstream}?

From now on, changes to the notes of {label} in the classes of this link ({classesText}) leave for the upstream {upstream} by themselves, about a minute after the last change, without you pressing Push Now. Turn it off here at any time.
Turn automatic push on for {label} to {upstream}?
builtin.upstreams.section.links.action.d: Asks the upstream what it already has for {label} and shows what a push would do. Nothing is stored there or here.
Run a dry run for {label} on {upstream}?
Not finished: run it again to go on
builtin.upstreams.section.links.action.l: Project there (empty: the same short name)
Allow private notes to be sent

In publish mode the published notes are written directly on the upstream, without its reviewers looking at them first. A note that changes there is never overwritten: it is listed as a conflict for you to settle. Once the link has sent notes its mode cannot be changed (unlink it and link it again). Each note carries the name of its author.

Nothing is sent until you push by hand (or turn automatic on for the link). What is sent arrives on the upstream as proposals for its reviewers to accept or reject. Each note carries the name of its author.
Allow private notes to be sent
builtin.upstreams.section.links.action.m: In publish mode the published notes are written directly on the upstream, without its reviewers looking at them first. A note that changes there is never overwritten: it is listed as a conflict for you to settle. A link that has already sent notes cannot change its mode: the gateway then refuses, and says so.

From the next push the notes go as proposals for the upstream's reviewers, instead of being written there directly. A link that has already sent notes cannot change its mode: the gateway then refuses, and says so.
builtin.upstreams.section.links.action.p: Sends the published notes of {label} to the upstream {upstream}: in submit mode as proposals for its reviewers, in publish mode written there directly (see the Mode column). For each note its title, class, kind and text, and one line at the end of the text with an opaque reference and the display name of the local author. Private notes go only if the link allows them. The device name and device ID of this gateway go in the connection. No note ids, revisions, paths or usage data leave. A note already sent is not sent again unless it changed.
Not finished: run it again to go on
builtin.upstreams.section.links.action.u: Nothing is sent for it any more. Notes already sent stay on the upstream, and nothing changes there.
builtin.upstreams.section.links.detail.s: Our change to this note is forgotten for the upstream: nothing is sent and nothing there is overwritten. The note here stays exactly as it is.
Our version of this note goes to the upstream as a new submission for its reviewers to accept or reject. Nothing there is overwritten. Later edits of this note also go as submissions.

builtin.upstreams.section.reading.title: Reading from upstream gateways
builtin.upstreams.section.readintro.body: Reading is the other direction. A link with reading on keeps a copy (a mirror) of the upstream's notes for the linked project; members of the local project find it in kb search, kb faq and note read, marked from hub, never as local notes. Reading is off until you accept its reach: the upstream, the project or team there, the classes and the extra sources (Dry Run shows it first). A link with reading on is pulled every 15 minutes unless you set another interval. If the upstream refuses, the mirror is deleted and the automatic pull stays off until you accept the reach again.
